mechanism.claim: The predictive sign of spot directional-underwater events can change across volatile regimes. Use only fully matured prior base-event directional returns to causally decide whether the current immutable spot-duration side should be followed or inverted.
mechanism.side: base side multiplied by strict sign of the arithmetic mean of the latest at most 12 fully matured base-event gross log returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVOER rotates generic 4h/12h experts only on winner changes. HVSAUDCA adapts the sign of a sparse path-duration event family at every eligible event using its own causally matured event labels, without future labels, stage resets, costs, funding, OI, premium, options, fitted thresholds, or promoted controls.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: immutable sparse HVSAUD event times retain passed Gross9 clock geometry while causal sign adaptation changes exposure

causal_label.value: immutable base side times log(perpetual exit_open/entry_open)
causal_label.maturity: label may enter memory only when base exit_time<=current decision_time
causal_label.memory: latest at most 12 mature labels in global chronological order
causal_label.score: arithmetic mean gross log label; strict nonzero required
causal_label.routing: score>0 keeps base side; score<0 inverts base side; zero or insufficient memory is cash
causal_label.forbidden: current or immature label, costs, funding, equity, PnL, CAGR, MDD, stage reset, future-stage fit

clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after Gross9

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.label_prices: bars_binance BTCUSDT exact five-minute opens at base entry/exit timestamps, read after preregistration
source_plan.current_candidate_execution_prices: sealed until source and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory causal online adaptation; not fresh confirmatory evidence
research_boundary.selection_basis: regime-robust causal sign adaptation with fixed event memory

stopping_rule: source including mature-label causality, Gross9, train/test/eval/final; terminal first failure; no base event, memory, minimum labels, label, maturity, score, tie, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
